resources.string: It leaves the feed and moves to the archive, where it is kept and can be restored at any time. The decision is yours, so it outranks anything a later sync concludes — a re-sync will not put it back.

When several apps record the same workout, the one highest in this list represents it in your feed. A source you turn off is still ingested — its recordings go to the archive.
